state_summary: Migrate two authenticated interaction management pages and four OBS SignalR routes from Blazor to Vue. Preserve existing APIs, hub contracts, identity-link semantics, and rollback aliases. No backend or production changes; native OBS verification remains user-owned.

agent_application.execution: Main agent owns OpenSpec, route/host integration, tests and final validation. A read-only survey mapped legacy behavior. Management UI and OBS UI are disjoint parallel candidates in isolated worktrees; no worker may merge or push.
agent_application.authorization: Ongoing user authorization covers implementation, board sync, branch push, and a Ready-for-review PR. Do not merge, deploy, alter production, or claim native OBS verification.
